contexts.text: (This) may appear strange. AC 647. AC 755:4. AC 969.
To sojourn = to live. AC 1463:3.
To sojourn () = to be instructed. AC 1463. Explained, Illustrated. AC 2025.
(Thus) the sojourning of Abram in Egypt = the Lord's instruction in childhood. AC 2496.
Thy seed shall be a stranger () = charity and faith rare. Explained.
A stranger = not born in the land.
(The true members of the Church are like strangers.)
The name Hagar means sojourner.
Sojourners represented those who were being instructed; and sojourning, instruction, and also things instituted for life.
Man only sojourns on earth.
Shall one come to sojourn... () = those in another doctrine, and life; (for) to sojourn = to be instructed and to live; thus doctrine and life.
(Sojourners a class of the good.)
The sojourning of Abram in Gerar = the Lord's instruction in doctrinal things. AC 2504. AC 2726.
Sojourners = those being instructed in truths and goods. AC 3703:19.
I am a sojourner and an inhabitant with you () = that although the Lord is unknown to them He can be with them.
The sojourning of the sons of Jacob in Egypt = the vastation of the Church.
Journeyings and peregrinations = the things of instruction, and thence of life.
Sojourn in this land () = instruction.
The land of thy sojournings () = the life of instructions.
To sojourn () = to be instructed.
The journeys or peregrinations of Abraham and Jacob, represented progressions into truths of faith and goods of love.

They called (converted) gentiles sojourners sojourning with them (illustrated) because to sojourn = to be instructed; and thus a sojourner = those who have suffered themselves to be instructed in the statutes and doctrinals.
Where Abraham and Isaac sojourned () = Divine life together. To sojourn = life.
Sojourner = those who want to be instructed in the truths of faith. AC 4956:2.
(Thus) when a sojourner is the subject of thought, as by him are signified those who are to be instructed, all exercises of charity towards such are suggested, thus truths.
To sojourn in the land are we come () = to seek life in scientifics. To sojourn = to be instructed, and also to live.
Sojournings () = life and instruction; thus successive states of life.
I am a sojourner in a strange land () = instructed in truths in a Church not his own. To be a sojourner = one being instructed in the things of the Church. AC 8650.
The land of their sojournings wherein they have sojourned () = where are the things of faith and charity about which they have been instructed, and according to which they have lived.
(The Ancients called those) sojourners whom they were to gather together.
When it treats of journeying, or peregrination.

Both a sojourner and one born in the hand () = one of the Church, whether not born there, or born there. A sojourner = one being instructed in the truths and goods of the Church, and who receives them; thus one not born within the Church, but who nevertheless accedes to it. AC 8002:3.

When a sojourner sojourneth with thee () = those who have been instructed in the truth and good of the Church, and who have received them... It is said when he sojourneth with thee because by to sojourn is signified to be instructed and to live. Thus by sojourners sojourning with them, are signified not only those who are being instructed in the truth and good of the Church, and who receive them; but also those who live according to them.

There shall be one law for the native and for the sojourner sojourning in the midst of you () = that he who on being instructed has received the truth and good of the Church, and lives according to them, shall be as he who is within the Church... AC 8013:3, Illustrated.
These things are signified by the peregrinations of the sons of Israel in the wilderness.
To go = to live; as also to journey, to progress, and to travel.
Nor the sojourner that is in thy gates () = the Scientific in general.

A sojourner thou shalt not afflict, and shalt not oppress () = that those who want to be instructed in the truths and goods of faith are not to be infested with falsities of faith and evils of life. Explained. AC 9268.
A sojourner = those who want to be instructed in such things as are of the Church.
The son of thine handmaid may take breath, and the sojourner () = the state of life of those who are in truths and goods outside the Church.
Those not born within the Church are signified by sojourners.
On this Earth there is an intercourse of all nations, by travellings, and by navigations.
Those who had acknowledged, and who had suffered themselves to be instructed, they called sojourners, who had the same rights as natives.
We said that we [had come] for the sake of travelling.
From the delight of travelling which they had contracted (here). For in other Earths there are not such travellings.
Monkish travellers, or missionaries.
The letter (is) in a strange style.
Whether you walk, or whether you travel.
If there were space... there would intervene a journey, and the time for a journey.
A journey to the court of a king.
After death his peregrinations (from one Society to another) are collected into one.
Our peregrini, by whom we mean the laity... [Citizens of a town who lived outside the walls were called peregrini.]
There is a kind of travelling (there). LJPost 231.
For there are such travellings on this Earth, and not elsewhere.
It is the custom to give strangers keys.
With the strangers who come thither they do thus...
Sojourners are all who do not know truths and goods, and who are to be instructed.
To sojourn = to be instructed. AE 654:16.
Sojourners = those outside the Church, who want to be instructed and to receive the doctrinals of the Church, and to live according to them. References.
Under Egypt, see this reference.
